objectives.description: Enumerate live Lean projects by scanning for Lake markers rather than trusting a list
objectives.note: `for d in ~/Projects/*/; do [ -f "$d/lakefile.lean" ] || [ -f "$d/lakefile.toml" ]; done` found: BimodalLogic, cslib, cslib.bak, cslib-pr648, ProofChecker.bak. DEVIATION FROM PLAN'S SCOPE HYPOTHESIS (recorded, not silently absorbed): the plan hypothesized exactly 3 active projects (cslib, BimodalLogic, cslib-pr648). The top-level ~/Projects/*/ scan alone would have missed a 4th real, currently-active project one directory deeper: ~/Projects/Logos/Theory (lakefile.lean present, git HEAD commit dated the same day as this implementation, lean extension already loaded in its own .claude-extensions.json, deployed setup/verify-lean-mcp.sh already present there). Per the plan's own Scope Hypothesis text ('the scan's output governs, and any project added or removed since planning is handled accordingly'), Logos/Theory was included as a 4th real project.

objectives.description: Register each real, active project at project scope, excluding backup/stale directories
objectives.note: cslib.bak and ProofChecker.bak excluded (backup directories, not actively used -- confirmed by the .bak suffix and the plan's own exclusion criterion; not independently probed for recent activity beyond that, matching the plan's own stated default). Registered: BimodalLogic (new), cslib (new), cslib-pr648 (already correct from Phase 4's real hook-fire test -- setup-lean-mcp.sh correctly reported 'already configured correctly, no changes needed'), Logos/Theory (new). Machine-local ~/.claude.json changes only, not a repository change.

objectives.description: Retire the top-level global entry with --retire-global
objectives.note: bash setup-lean-mcp.sh --retire-global -- confirmed via jq that .mcpServers."lean-lsp" is now absent and .projects is untouched.

objectives.description: Run the Phase 5 verifier from each registered project directory and confirm exit 0
objectives.note: Ran BOTH the source-store verifier directly (all 4 projects, exit 0) and, for the 3 projects that have a repository .claude/ deploy (BimodalLogic, cslib, Logos/Theory -- redeployed first to pick up the relocated/inverted scripts), the DEPLOYED .claude/scripts/verify-lean-mcp.sh --quiet (all PASS, exit 0). cslib-pr648 has no .claude/ deploy at all by design (the exact worktree scenario), so only the source-store verifier applies there; recorded rather than treated as a gap.

objectives.description: Record the before/after jq output in the progress file
objectives.note: BEFORE: .mcpServers."lean-lsp" pointed at BimodalLogic; only cslib-pr648 had a .projects entry (from Phase 4's real end-to-end hook test). AFTER: .mcpServers."lean-lsp" is ABSENT; .projects entries exist for exactly Logos/Theory, BimodalLogic, cslib, and cslib-pr648, each with env.LEAN_PROJECT_PATH equal to its OWN path. Snapshotted ~/.claude.json to ~/.claude.json.bak-205 before making any of these changes, per the plan's Rollback/Contingency section.
